name: Image
purpose: Renders an image with loading state, error fallback, and optional caption.
scenarios: Display a user avatar with fallback

alt.description: Alternative text; empty string marks decorative images.

errorLabel.description: Text shown when the image fails to load.

states.name: error
states.description: Image failed to load; fallback shown.

antiPatterns: Do not omit alt text for informative images.
Do not use an image to present text that could be real text.

a11y.labeling: alt attribute carries the text alternative; caption uses figcaption.

responsive.strategy: Scales to container width while preserving aspect ratio.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction inherits from document lang/dir.
